artifact.type: Chrome extension, Web, backend, iOS, and Codex plugin synthetic evidence-to-action system

scenario: A recruiter intentionally captures the exact synthetic TS-CORE-01 selected text, reviews evidence-backed proposed state, keeps confirmation and execution authority separate, prepares one recruiter-owned question, and reads back a truthful local outcome across Chrome, Web, iOS, and the Codex plugin without any external write.

review_plan.reason: Owns intentional capture, evidence provenance, retention, authority separation, deletion, and external-write vetoes.
Owns iOS task completion, AX5, recovery, and truthful assistive-technology evidence limits.
Owns cross-surface recruiter comprehension, task continuity, and first-use operational fit.
The unchanged frozen contract continues to prohibit candidate scoring, fit, personality, protected-trait, and acceptance claims; deterministic refusal remains covered by the shared and iOS gates.
No candidate-facing communication, automation, or external effect was introduced in this final integration retest.

reviews.lens: intentional evidence capture, provenance, retention, authority separation, and safe action

findings.observation: The synthetic journey preserves governed fixture lineage rather than defining a locator for future non-synthetic sources.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/round-4/chrome/trace.json and evidence-safety-reviewer.json keep real evidence outside the enabled contract.
findings.user_impact: This is safe and truthful for the current release slice, but real evidence cannot be enabled without a minimized provenance and deletion design.
findings.recommendation: Keep non-synthetic capture disabled until a purpose-limited, access-controlled, deletable locator contract passes review.
findings.verification: A future design proves source-specific provenance without retaining unrelated browsing history.

strengths: Visible user Chrome proves the selected-text gesture, positive temporary activeTab path, exact preview, pre-Submit silence, one explicit Submit, receipt, and Workspace readback.
The captured state remains proposal-only with zero confirmed facts, zero approvals, and zero effect attempts or observations.
Retention shape, expiry, purge, deletion lineage, retry-cache scrubbing, duplicate handling, and account isolation remain directly evidenced.
XS-CAPTURE-01 and XS-RETENTION-01 are resolved, and no external write occurred.
missing_evidence: A governed real-source locator contract and candidate-facing access/deletion route remain outside this synthetic recruiter-only slice.
open_questions: What is the minimum useful source locator that preserves auditability without becoming browsing surveillance?

reviews.lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, interruption, and recovery

findings.observation: The iOS 26.1 Simulator exposes neither VoiceOver in Settings nor a simctl VoiceOver control, so speech, gesture traversal, and focus transitions remain unproven.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/round-4/ios/accessibility-trace.json records the direct availability checks and explicitly separates tree evidence from VoiceOver proof.
findings.user_impact: Touch and accessibility-tree behavior are strong, but a VoiceOver user could still encounter unclear repeated controls or lost focus after state changes.
findings.recommendation: Run the frozen journey on a real iPhone or another environment that actually exposes VoiceOver.
findings.verification: One direct trace proves spoken identity, evidence, proposal status, contextual actions, exact effect, no-external-write outcome, cancellation, failure, retry, and predictable focus.

strengths: The corrected focused AX5 audit passes 1/1 and the complete iOS UI suite passes 12/12 with zero failures or skips.
The canonical localhost state, evidence-first review, four decisions, separate action preview, local outcome, interruption, cancellation, stale state, and recovery all pass.
Passing screenshots show the full dark-mode AX5 instruction and safe status-bar and viewport behavior.
missing_evidence: A true VoiceOver transcript and visible focus trace.
Assistive-technology user evidence and a smallest-supported-iPhone layout run.
open_questions: Will repeated Confirm, Edit, and Dismiss controls remain contextually clear when heard linearly?

reviews.lens: time-constrained recruiter task completion, cross-surface continuity, and first-use comprehension

findings.observation: The complete synthetic flow is directly executable, but no first-time recruiter independently narrated the distinction between receipt, proposal, confirmation, approval, authority, and observed outcome.
findings.evidence: Chrome, Web, iOS, backend, and plugin evidence prove the implemented sequence; docs/evaluations/round-4/web/panel.json records the missing uncoached walkthrough.
findings.user_impact: The system is usable, but onboarding language may still require refinement before a new recruiter understands every authority boundary without help.
findings.recommendation: Run one uncoached recruiter walkthrough using the same frozen case.
findings.verification: The recruiter completes the journey without prompting and accurately explains each state transition and the absence of an external write.

strengths: Chrome capture, Web receipt/readback, iOS review, backend state, and plugin proposal all align on the same TS-CORE-01 evidence.
The Web production build, 43 Web tests, 15 backend unit tests, 8-case shared evaluation, and plugin fixture suite pass.
The system stays quiet: one intentional capture, one receipt, one recruiter-owned proposal, and no candidate contact or external effect.
missing_evidence: A field timing comparison against the recruiter's current manual workflow.
Native browser 200% zoom and manual screen-reader traversal.
open_questions: Can a new recruiter explain the authority model after one pass without product-team vocabulary?

top_findings.reason: The available Simulator cannot execute VoiceOver, and tree evidence is not promoted to spoken or focus proof.
top_findings.next_step: Run the frozen journey on a real VoiceOver-capable device.
top_findings.verification: Speech, swipe order, actions, focus transitions, exact effect, outcome, cancellation, failure, and retry are direct.

top_findings.reason: No first-time recruiter has independently explained the full authority sequence.
top_findings.verification: The participant completes the flow and accurately distinguishes receipt, proposal, confirmation, approval, authority, and observed outcome.

top_findings.reason: The safe current slice is synthetic; real-source provenance and candidate access/deletion remain deliberately unimplemented.
top_findings.next_step: Keep real evidence disabled until its minimized provenance, access, and deletion contract is reviewed.
top_findings.verification: A future real-source design is purpose-limited, access-controlled, deletable, and cannot expose unrelated browsing data.

agreements: The same TS-CORE-01 evidence remains exact and attributable across Chrome, Web, backend, iOS, and plugin outputs.
Evidence, proposal, confirmed local state, action approval, execution authority, effect attempt, and observed outcome remain separate.
The visible Chrome permission boundary and pre-Submit silence are now direct; XS-CAPTURE-01 is resolved.
Retention enforcement and migration truth remain direct; XS-RETENTION-01 is resolved.
The AX5 finding is resolved by a focused pass and a 12/12 full iOS UI pass.
No active veto and no candidate contact, calendar, message, ATS, CRM, or other external write remain.

veto_resolution.veto: XS-CAPTURE-01: intentional user Chrome selected-text capture and pre-Submit silence were unproven.
veto_resolution.evidence: docs/evaluations/round-4/chrome/trace.json and panel.json prove the visible gesture, positive temporary grant, exact preview, zero capture POST before Submit, exactly one Submit, one receipt, and Workspace readback.

veto_resolution.veto: XS-RETENTION-01: minimized payload enforcement, expiry, purge, deletion lineage, migration truth, and retry-cache scrubbing required re-verification.
veto_resolution.evidence: docs/evaluations/round-3/final/localhost-backend-retention.json and legacy-migration.json remain unchanged and authoritative.

adjudication.rationale: All deterministic compiler, documentation, Web, backend, iOS, extension, plugin, retention, and eight-case gates are green, and the visible Chrome user boundary resolves the last active blocker. Veto-first adjudication therefore permits the synthetic local system to pass with changes. Full accessibility and field-readiness claims remain gated by direct VoiceOver and uncoached recruiter evidence; non-synthetic capture and external effects remain disabled.

next_tests.test: Traverse frozen TS-CORE-01 with real VoiceOver.
next_tests.evidence_required: Spoken transcript or recording plus visible focus trace across review, action, outcome, cancellation, failure, and retry.
next_tests.pass_condition: Every state and control is contextual, ordered, reachable, and focus returns predictably.

next_tests.test: Run one uncoached first-time recruiter walkthrough.
next_tests.evidence_required: Task recording, completion time, errors, and the participant's own explanation of authority boundaries.
next_tests.pass_condition: Completion without prompting or false claims about confirmation, approval, or external outcome.

next_tests.test: Review the future non-synthetic source locator, candidate access, and deletion contract before enabling it.
next_tests.evidence_required: Purpose, minimization, authorization, retention, access, deletion, and unrelated-browsing isolation proof.
next_tests.pass_condition: No unrelated browsing data is exposed or retained, and deletion is complete and auditable.
